start.text: It's contained. The malware has stopped, but now we have to see what it left behind.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Good work. But stopped is not fixed. A crashed laptop, an old hole and a quiet spy are still waiting for us.
A.name: Carla

B.text: Anything it touched is still broken, or still open to it. We can't let people go back to work like that.
B.name: Carla

C1.text: Walk through the office and look for machines marked with a [b][color=red]![/color][/b]. Start with the program Ben started, and fix the rest from there.
C1.name: Carla

C2.text: Not yet. His protection has to be back on, and the bad program has to go. Otherwise it can start again.
C2.name: Carla

D.text: Fix one thing at a time. When everything is repaired, we run a [b][color=green]final check[/color][/b] before anyone gets back to work.
D.name: Carla

E.text: Got it. Clean up first, then check. I don't want Ben to lose his work.
E.name: Joshua
